acceptance_criteria: field inspection and a non-vacuous compile-time negative assertion; CHK-05, CHK-20, NEG-03, NEG-05.
statement: The unit's bounded values (`ActionPathConfig`, `EndpointGeneration`, `EmulationLease`, `LeaseSnapshot`, `PendingAction`, `SyntheticStimulationItem`, `ActionDiagnostic`, `ActionPathSnapshot`, `CompletionReport`) **shall** carry no payload, value body, address, free-form text, or unbounded member; a declared per-action payload view **shall** be forwarded to the emission seam only and **shall** be retained, journaled, or logged by nothing; the pending queue, lease table, and lineage window **shall** be bounded by declared maxima; and a compile-time rule **shall** reject construction from a payload byte container or free-form text and **shall** bound each value's size.
title: T028 requirement 004
verification_intent: field inspection and a non-vacuous compile-time negative assertion; CHK-05, CHK-20, NEG-03, NEG-05.
